title: Minimum per-attempt evaluation log (eval_log_min)
description: One attempt per object. Fields whose values cannot be reconstructed after the run are required. A field that is not captured at the time makes later verification partial, not lenient.

attempt_id.description: Unique per attempt; the key every later audit joins on.

cell_id.description: Task x configuration x stratum identifier the attempt belongs to.

config_id.description: Policy, checkpoint or hardware configuration under test.

seed.description: Generator seed. A null is not allowed: an unseeded attempt cannot be recomputed.

init_state_digest.description: sha256 of the initial state or scene manifest, proving attempts started from the same state.

termination_reason.description: A bare outcome flag cannot tell success from a timeout that was later counted as failure.

scoring_method.description: Who judged the outcome. Mixing the two without recording which was used makes rater variance invisible.

rerun_flag.description: True when this attempt replaces or follows an earlier attempt on the same cell.

replacement_flag.description: True when this attempt was substituted for a discarded one. Dropping attempts changes the denominator.
